## The JUCE Framework Dependencies

The JUCE modules contain the following dependencies (see upstream `LICENSE.md` for paths in the JUCE tree):

- AudioUnitSDK (Apache 2.0)
- Oboe (Apache 2.0)
- FLAC (BSD)
- GLEW, Mesa, Khronos (BSD / MIT, per upstream)
- Ogg Vorbis (BSD)
- jpeglib (Independent JPEG Group License)
- CHOC, QuickJS (ISC / MIT, per upstream)
- LV2 (ISC)
- pslextensions (Public domain)
- AAX (Proprietary Avid AAX License / GPLv3, per SDK)
- VST3 (Proprietary Steinberg VST3 License / GPLv3, per SDK)
- Box2D (zlib)
- pnglib (zlib)
- zlib
- HarfBuzz (Old MIT)
- SheenBidi (Apache)

The JUCE examples are licensed under the [ISC license](http://www.isc.org/downloads/software-support-policy/isc-license/).
